svg.text: Phase 2 · step 4g · Groups, and roles on a group or one vehicle (decision #052): two options each
Admin mode only. Groups get their own screen under Manage; the Users screen gives roles on all vehicles, one group, or one vehicle. Roles add up: on each vehicle, the highest applies.
A · Cards: one card per group with its vehicles; Edit opens a dialog (name, icon, delete when empty)
Moving a vehicle stays on its own page (Setup → Move, with the preview).
The list of vehicles links to each one.
A · Edit dialog (also Add group, without Delete)
Delete shows only for an empty group that isn't the last;
otherwise it's greyed out with the reason:
“Move this group's vehicles to another group first.”
+ Every group at a glance, with its vehicles.
− Who-sees-it is a one-line summary only.
B · List and detail (like Users): groups on the left; the chosen group's name, icon, vehicles, and who sees it on the right
Only when empty, and not the last group.
Name and icon save when changed. Roles are set on the Users screen.
Phone · B: the list, then a page per group
+ Who can see a group is right there,
before you move vehicles into it.
Roles on the Users screen (Alex chosen)
A · A list of roles, each with its own menu; + Add role picks all vehicles, a group, or one vehicle
Wide · Users → Alex (Admin mode; the list column is unchanged)
Roles add up: on each vehicle, the highest applies. So Alex is a Maintainer on the Cub,
a Driver on the Truck, and a Viewer on everything else.
+ Short: only the roles Alex has.
− The effect on each vehicle is in the note,
B · Everything listed: all vehicles, each group, and its vehicles, each with a menu; what applies is shown when it's inherited
“—” means no role of its own here; the line beside it says what applies.
+ Shows exactly what Alex can do on
+ No dialog: change any menu in place.
